launch_http_server_engine: launch an HTTP server engine adapter with server arguments and wait for health check
generate_text_completion: generate text completions using prompts, sampling params, and optional image data through the HTTP server
update_model_weights: update model weights from serialized tensor data with optional flush cache on the running server
manage_memory_occupation: release and resume GPU memory occupation for the running server engine
shutdown_server_engine: shutdown the HTTP server engine process and kill its process tree gracefully
